Subject: ClusterSet
Slot Definition: One or more cluster sets from which this taxonomy was derived.

Subject: ClusterSet
Slot Definition: The cluster set to which this cluster belongs.

Subject: CellTypeTaxon
Notes: Annotation lives on the Cluster→CellTypeTaxon edge; cells inherit label via Cell.part_of_cluster

Subject: CellTypeSet
Slot Definition: The next broader annotation level in the taxonomy hierarchy (e.g. Subclass has_parent Class).

Subject: CellTypeTaxonomy
Slot Definition: The taxonomy for which this annotation level is defined.

Subject: CellTypeTaxon
Slot Definition: Reference to the parent taxon at the next broader annotation level.

Subject: CellTypeSet
Slot Definition: The annotation level (CellTypeSet) for which this taxon is a member.

Subject: Cluster
Slot Definition: The cluster to which this cell has been assigned by the clustering algorithm.
Notes: Object reference for Cell.cluster_id string value

Subject: Embedding
Slot Definition: One or more dimensionality reductions associated with this taxonomy.
Notes: No BKE equivalent; AIT-specific analysis component

Subject: ExpressionMatrix
Slot Definition: One or more cell-by-gene matrices associated with this taxonomy (normalized and/or raw counts).

Subject: GeneAnnotation
Slot Definition: One of the genes (variables) measured across all cells in this matrix; corresponds to a column in var.

Subject: GeneAnnotation
Slot Definition: Marker genes in the primate species that are related to the respective cell type.

Subject: GeneAnnotation
Slot Definition: Marker genes in the mouse species that are related to the respective cell type.
